wireContract: Adds the public GET /public/hns/namespaces/v1 (ListHnsNamespaces): version 1, a millisecond generated_at and up to 256 unique sorted LDH roots, each with an expires_at after generated_at. Its only declared error is InternalError and its cache policy is private, no-store. No existing operation changes.
